settings.worktree_baseref_hint: Each additional split pane works in its own worktree. With the default branch, every session starts clean without inheriting the commits of whatever branch you are on. Does not affect already-created worktrees.
settings.remote_hint: Control Devia from a messaging platform while the app is open. What you type runs in the active project and is mirrored in the app.
settings.auto_continue_hint: Devia will automatically continue a session that was interrupted because your subscription account limit ran out.
settings.remote_chat_id_hint: (only that chat can control the app)
settings.remote_test_fail: Could not connect. Check the API Key.
settings.remote_allow_shell_hint: Off by default: it grants command execution to whoever controls the chat.
settings.remote_allow_file_send: Allow Devia to send files to the chat
settings.remote_allow_file_send_hint: Only files inside the workspace. .env files, SSH keys and secret files are never sent. Max. 50 MB.
settings.remote_allow_file_send_privacy: Privacy: the content of sent files leaves your computer and is uploaded to Telegram's servers.
settings.remote_mirror_desktop: Mirror desktop conversations to the chat
settings.remote_mirror_desktop_hint: When on, every conversation you start in the app is also sent to the Telegram chat, labelled with the project.
settings.remote_more_soon: More integrations besides Telegram are coming.

ui_tools.title: Tools offered to the agent
ui_tools.hint: Every schema rides in the cached prompt prefix on each turn. Turning one off withholds it from all runs.
ui_tools.total: Active set costs ~{{tokens}} tokens per turn
ui_tools.agent_unsupported: The «{{agent}}» agent has no MCP support: it will receive none of these tools.
ui_tools.grants_hint: They match by exact equality, never by prefix. Revoke them once you no longer need them.
ui_tools.grants_empty: No pre-authorised actions in this project.

settings.memory_hint: Devia stores decisions, conventions and discoveries and exposes them to agents through its internal MCP.
settings.memory_block_engram_label: Block the Engram MCP when running agents from Devia
settings.memory_block_engram_hint: Prevents saturating the context with Engram's tools. The block is applied via an invocation argument; it does not modify the agents' config files.
settings.memory_block_unsupported: The Engram block can't be applied to {{agent}} per invocation; its tools may stay active.
settings.memory_provider_hint_devia: Recommended. Devia's internal memory: works with any CLI, zero install. Isolates the run so no external memory MCP interferes.
settings.memory_provider_hint_external: Devia turns off its memory and lets your external memory MCP (e.g. engram) handle context. Only covers CLIs that support it (Claude, OpenCode).
settings.memory_provider_hint_none: No persistent memory. Devia injects none and isolates the run from any external memory MCP.
settings.memory_saved_hint: Observations in your personal memory. Pin the important ones or remove what you don't want to keep.
settings.memory_clear_message: Delete all of Devia's saved memory?
settings.memory_engram_detected: Engram was detected on this machine.
settings.memory_engram_absent: Engram was not detected on this machine.
settings.title: Settings
settings.agent_hint: Choose which CLI executes your instructions.
settings.env_hint: Only apply to {{agent}}. Leave empty to use system defaults.
settings.accent_hint: Change the accent color across the app. The preview applies instantly.

session_import.intro: Select the conversations you want to import. "Native resume" sessions continue with their full original context; "Replay" sessions re-seed the transcript on the next turn.
session_import.settings_hint: Import conversations you already had with Claude Code or Codex into Devia.
session_import.resumable_hint: Continuing resumes the agent's real conversation with full context.
session_import.replay_hint: No native resume: the transcript is re-seeded on the next turn.

toasts.session_import_offer: We found agent sessions you can import into Devia.
